title: Sex-Stratified Machine Learning for the Prediction of Post-COVID Condition: A Longitudinal Cohort Study.
summary: Sex-stratified machine-learning models predicted post-COVID condition in a longitudinal cohort with modest discrimination and temporal-cohort evidence. This supports limited predictive utility in the studied population, not clinical benefit.
ai_technology: Sex-stratified machine-learning models predict post-COVID condition.
organization: ISP RAS Research Center for Trusted Artificial Intelligence, 109004 Moscow, Russia

evidence.tested: Longitudinal cohort and temporal evaluation; discrimination was modest and prospective clinical utility was not tested.
evidence.unknown: External replication and real-world or clinical benefit were not established by the reviewed study
evidence.ai_role: Sex-stratified machine-learning models predict post-COVID condition.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
